subject.title: [codex] fix(feishu): preserve post markdown line breaks

question: Which Feishu newline candidate should become the canonical branch after the channel-entry chunking gap is fixed and real Feishu proof is available?
rationale: Multiple open PRs target the same Feishu post+md newline bug, and this draft branch now has a concrete merge blocker plus missing live proof; automation should not choose the permanent branch shape for maintainers.

options.title: Fix and prove a canonical branch
options.body: Require the selected branch to normalize before the channel entry chunk limit, rebase cleanly, and attach redacted live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt a stronger sibling PR
options.body: If another open sibling has cleaner code and better proof, make that branch canonical and close duplicates after preserving useful tests.

options.title: Pause for owner selection
options.body: Leave the candidate PRs open until the Feishu plugin owner chooses the exact normalization and chunking shape.

recommendation.title: Fix and prove a canonical branch
recommendation.body: Require the selected branch to normalize before the channel entry chunk limit, rebase cleanly, and attach redacted live Feishu proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies m1heng as the Feishu/Lark plugin’s community owner, making them the best available owner for selecting the canonical fix shape.
